ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command Line
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious powershell process starts with base64 encoded commands (e.g. Emotet)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ JAB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ SUVYI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ SQBFAFgA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ aQBlAHgA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ aWV4I.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ IAA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ IAB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ UwB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cwB.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\-ENCOD\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ BA\\^J\\ e\\-.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ExecutionPolicy\\ remotesigned\\ .*"))
